name: codedp-bench-pii-extraction-cpt
description: A benchmark for extracting personally identifiable information (PII) from text/code contexts, measuring models' ability to detect and correctly extract sensitive fields. It evaluates structured extraction performance across varied examples intended to simulate real-world PII disclosure scenarios. The dataset is targeted at evaluating privacy-sensitive information extraction robustness.
reputation: A niche, dataset-specific benchmark hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use for PII extraction evaluations.
